name: Afterglow
thesis: Otium becomes a quiet evening instrument, with warm serif typography suspended above a dark, recessed picture frame.
difference: Near-black matte ground, generous Newsreader headings, bronze source names, gently desaturated inset pictures, and a single transport rail for the finite session instead of app tabs.
tradeoff: Its deliberate nighttime character is less bright and casual than a daylight reader, and Saved is one level away from the main story.
lens: A high-end cinema and hi-fi product designer making an analog, serif-led evening reading instrument.
